quarterly_data.signal: Nidec will establish a Software Technology Development Center under its CTO on October 01, 2026 (in Nidec Shin-Kawasaki Technology Center, Kawasaki) to integrate the whole group's software and accelerate its structural shift from a component-supplying business to a module and solution enterprise; NIDEC ADVANCE TECHNOLOGY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (Bangalore) moves under the company's direct control and is to be renamed NIDEC INDIA SOFTWARE CENTER PRIVATE LIMITED on November 01, 2026 (plan) as the global site leading group software development.
